purpose: Compact added, removed, and modified line-count summary that accompanies a Markdown diff view.
useWhen: Surfacing a quick numeric summary of changes alongside or in lieu of a full diff surface.
Annotating a list of files or pull requests with line-change counts as part of the source-diff-viewer suite.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering the actual hunked diff content — pair with `DiffViewer` from `@lostgradient/editor` for the full document comparison.
Generic numeric badges that have nothing to do with diffs — reach for stat or badge instead.
